title: v0.40.12
description: Liquid AI LFM3 LFM3 is Liquid AI's new family of small models built for local agents, tool calling, and structured output, on Liquid's new tri-hybrid architecture. The family includes: lfm3 : a 1.7B text model with a 256K-token context window lfm3-vl : adds image understanding lfm3-audio : speech recognition, translation, and text-to-speech in 18 languages lfm3-omni : text, images, and audio in one model ollama run lfm3 d1 decision models Liquid AI's d1 models now come in a 2B size, built on LFM

title: v0.40.12-rc1
description: mlx: add LFM3 and d1 models ( #19333 )

title: v0.40.11
description: Speech Ollama can now generate speech on macOS. ollama run plays text or a chat model's reply aloud as the audio is generated, and apps can stream audio through the OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/speech endpoint. ollama run phonon " Hello from Ollama. " d3 decision models d3 brings vLLM Semantic Router's decision models to Ollama. Give a model text, structured state, or an image, and ask it to classify, answer yes or no, or score options with probabilities. The family includes 2B, 4B, 9B, and 27B s

title: v0.40.10
description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B is NVIDIA’s smaller, Gemma 4-based vision-language model for fast local conversations, image understanding, and tool use. It supports a 128K-token context window. The model includes a DFlash draft for speculative decoding. ollama run nemotron-3.5-bolt:e4b Full Changelog : v0.40.9...v0.40.10

title: v0.40.10-rc0: Update gemma renderers (#19241)
description: renderers: add gemma4-nemotron renderer Add a Gemma 4 renderer variant that renders assistant content before its tool calls rather than after the tool responses. Models opt in with RENDERER gemma4-nemotron; gemma4 auto-detection is unchanged. Adds the corresponding chat template as a test fixture for Jinja parity checks. mlx: support Gemma 4 targets with DFlash drafts Load a draft-owned output head when its config requires one, while preserving the target-head path used by existing DFlash models
